---
title: "Merging_POCA_datasets"
author: "Andrew Becker"
output: html_document
date: "2023-07-10"
R_version: "4.4.2"
description: "Merges multiple proteomics result files into a single combined dataframe and applies gene name annotations from a UniProt reference database. Handles both homo sapiens and non-human protein entries."
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --- SETUP: Load required libraries ---
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(here)
library(pbapply)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(readxl)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)

# --- LOAD CONFIGURATION ---
source(here::here("src", "config.R"))
```

```{r data_loading_lookup}
# --- DATA LOADING: Create lookup table ---
# Lookup table should have two columns:
#   "ProteinID" (no space between 'n' and 'I') and "label" (gene identifier)
# If exporting from UniProt reviewed proteome, use "Gene Names (primary)" as "label"
setwd("~/R_data/AB_merging_script_troubleshooting_18july25/")
df.labels <- read.csv("uniprot_accession_gene.csv")
lookup <- df.labels[, c("ProteinID", "label")]
```

```{r data_loading_results}
# --- DATA LOADING: Read results files ---
# Results files should have these headers exactly:
# "foldchange"  "p_value"  "ProteinID"  "label"  "diffexpressed"
# Note: "label" is the gene name and "ProteinID" is the UniProt accession identifier
df1 <- read.csv("EB-B-012-chol-JF570_plusminus-hv_FC1-p05.csv")
df2 <- read.csv("EB-B-012-palm-JF570_plusminus-hv_FC1-p05.csv")
```

```{r data_processing_merge1}
# --- DATA PROCESSING: MERGE 1 ---
# Direct merge based on "ProteinID" (UniProt Accession)
# Use this for 100% homo sapiens datasets
df_list <- list(mBCD.chol.JF570.HEK.rep1 = df1, mBCD.palm.JF570.HEK = df2)

df_list <- lapply(df_list, function(df) {
  df$label <- NULL # remove existing label
  df <- merge(df, lookup, by = "ProteinID", all.x = TRUE)
  return(df)
})

# Renaming columns with experiment-specific suffixes
df_list <- lapply(names(df_list), function(x) {
  df <- df_list[[x]]
  names(df)[names(df) %in% c("foldchange", "p_value", "diffexpressed")] <- 
    paste0(c("foldchange", "p_value", "diffexpressed"), ".", x)
  return(df)
})

merged_df <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = c("ProteinID", "label"), all = TRUE), df_list)
```

```{r data_processing_merge2}
# --- DATA PROCESSING: MERGE 2 ---
# Fallback merge that preserves original labels if UniProt match not found
# Use this if MERGE 1 gives an error (e.g., non-human proteins in dataset)
df_list <- list(mBCD.chol.JF570.HEK.rep1 = df1, mBCD.palm.JF570.HEK = df2)
df_list <- lapply(df_list, function(df) {
  # Rename the original label column to original_label
  names(df)[names(df) == "label"] <- "original_label"
  
  # Merge with lookup table
  df <- merge(df, lookup, by = "ProteinID", all.x = TRUE)
  
  # Use original_label if label from lookup is NA
  df$label <- ifelse(is.na(df$label), df$original_label, df$label)
  
  # Remove the original_label column
  df$original_label <- NULL
  
  return(df)
})

# Renaming columns with experiment-specific suffixes
df_list <- lapply(names(df_list), function(x) {
  df <- df_list[[x]]
  names(df)[names(df) %in% c("foldchange", "p_value", "diffexpressed")] <- 
    paste0(c("foldchange", "p_value", "diffexpressed"), ".", x)
  return(df)
})

# Final merge
merged_df <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = c("ProteinID", "label"), all = TRUE), df_list)
```

```{r export}
# --- EXPORT: Save merged dataframe ---
write.csv(merged_df, file = "Merged_your_title_here.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
